d:
Dipavli khushiyon, roshni aur utsav ka tyohar hai. is dauran gharon se lekar bajaron tak raunak rahti hai aur bachche aatishbaji ka aanand lete hain. tyohar ke is utsah ke bich aankhon ki sehat ko najraandaj karna bhari par sakta hai. dipavli ka samay mausam men badlav aur vayumandal men dhul-kanon ki adhikta ka bhi daur hota hai.
